record.original_question: For every successor cardinal κ, must the negative relation \((2^κ over κ) ↛ (2^κ over κ)^(1,1)_2\) hold? Equivalently, is there always a 2-coloring of 2^κ × κ with no monochromatic rectangle of sizes 2^κ and κ?

evidence.quote: Problem 3.1. Does the negative relation (2^κ over κ) ↛ (2^κ over κ)^(1,1)_2 hold for every successor cardinal κ?

artifact.self_contained_problem:
For an infinite cardinal κ, write the polarized partition relation
$$\binom{2^{\kappa}}{\kappa} \to \binom{2^{\kappa}}{\kappa}^{1,1}_{2}$$
to mean: for every coloring $c : 2^{\kappa} \times \kappa \to \{0,1\}$ there exist $A \subseteq 2^{\kappa}$ with $|A| = 2^{\kappa}$ and $B \subseteq \kappa$ with $|B| = \kappa$ such that $c \!\restriction\! (A \times B)$ is constant. The negation
$$\binom{2^{\kappa}}{\kappa} \not\to \binom{2^{\kappa}}{\kappa}^{1,1}_{2}$$
asserts the existence of a 2-coloring $c : 2^{\kappa} \times \kappa \to \{0,1\}$ admitting no such monochromatic rectangle of dimensions $2^{\kappa} \times \kappa$.

Question: Does the negative relation $\binom{2^{\kappa}}{\kappa} \not\to \binom{2^{\kappa}}{\kappa}^{1,1}_{2}$ hold (provably in ZFC) for every successor cardinal κ?
artifact.status_search_result: The question is posed in the Garti–Shelah list of open and solved problems on polarized partition relations (published in Fundamenta Mathematicae, 2016). Subsequent works by Garti, Shelah, and others (e.g., on random reals and polarized colorings, and on cardinal characteristics and partitions) establish related negative polarized relations under additional set-theoretic assumptions, but no source was found establishing or refuting the relation in ZFC for every successor cardinal κ. Current status appears unresolved based on available sources.

status_evidence.title: Open and solved problems concerning polarized partition relations
status_evidence.snippet: Garti and Shelah list open problems on polarized partition relations and solve some by forcing constructions.
status_evidence.claim: The problem is recorded as an open problem on polarized partition relations.

status_evidence.title: Random reals and polarized colorings
status_evidence.snippet: Garti–Shelah show that random reals yield downward negative polarized relations.
status_evidence.claim: Related negative polarized relations have been obtained only under extra hypotheses, not in ZFC for all successor κ.

status_evidence.title: Cardinal characteristics of the continuum and partitions
status_evidence.snippet: Further work by Garti–Shelah on partition relations connected to cardinal invariants.
status_evidence.claim: No general ZFC resolution for all successor cardinals is reported.
